senses.gloss: c. (cmp. צלף) [glittering, pealing,] hoof, esp. (b. h. פרסה) cloven foot.
units: B. Bath. 75ᵇ; Kidd. 22ᵇ אחזה בטַלְפָהּ if he seized the animal by its hoof.—Du. טְלָפַיִים, טְלָפַיִם, טְלָפַיִין, pl. טְלָפִים (?), טְלָפוֹת.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 2:2">Par. II, 2</cite> <he>שקרניה וטְלָפֶיהָ וכ׳</he>; Bekh. l. c. <he>שקרנים וטלפים</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 6:9">Nidd. VI, 9</cite> <he>יש לו ט׳</he> has cloven feet.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:4">Ruth R. to III, 13</cite> <he>מטַלְפֵי סוסי</he> by the hoofs of my horse (counting his steps, I know the distance); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8">Koh. R. to VII, 8</cite> (v. <cite ref="I00522">next w.</cite>).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:17">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ואין טְלָפֶיהָ סדוקות</he> and are not her feet cloven (is she not clean for you, fit to be your wife)?—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:12">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 11</cite> <he>טַלְפוֹת סוסיהן וכ׳</he> the hoofs of their horses fell off; a. e. [<cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 2:10">Tosef. Ukts. II, 10</cite> <he>טלפין</he> Var., v. <cite ref="M01192"><he>מילפפון</he></cite>.]
